title: On R-disjoint graphs: a generalization of almost bipartite non-König-Egerváry graphs
summary: An almost bipartite graph is a graph with a unique odd cycle. Levit and Mandrescu showed that in every non-König--Egerváry almost bipartite graph the equalities $\textnormal{ker}(G)=\textnormal{core}(G)$, $\textnormal{corona}(G)\cup N(\textnormal{core}(G)) = V(G)$ and $\left|\textnormal{corona}(G)\right|+\left|\textnormal{core}(G)\right|=2α(G)+1$ hold. In this work, we present a generalization of this theory by introducing the family of $R$-disjoint graphs, which contains all non-König--Egerváry almost bipartite graphs, allowing the presence of multiple odd cycles under connectivity…
